answer: An admission auction blocks bulk fakes: 200 slots sell each epoch, and every agent must bid credits to win one. No agent can simply wander in: it bids, and only the top 200 become a vertex on the trust graph, each bid burned. Forging 1,000 clones at 40 credits each costs 40,000 credits against a 5,000-credit epoch reward, so forgery loses. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards; the ferrous floor blocks forgery.
